segments.tha-ap530:2.3: Duve bhave saṃsarāmi, devatte cāpi mānuse.
segments.tha-ap530:3.3: Duve kule pajāyāmi, khattiye cāpi brāhmaṇe.
segments.tha-ap530:5.1: “Devaloke manusse vā, jāto vā yattha katthaci;
segments.tha-ap530:6.1: “Mudukā maddavā sniddhā [mudu maddavā siniddhā (syā.)], sukhumā sukumārikā;
segments.tha-ap530:6.3: Chavi me sabbadā hoti, bodhipatte suchaḍḍite [suchaḍḍine (sī.)].
segments.tha-ap530:8.3: Gatte sedā na muccanti, vipāko pattachaḍḍite.
segments.tha-ap530:9.1: “Kuṭṭhaṃ gaṇḍo kilāso ca, tilakā piḷakā tathā;
segments.tha-ap530:9.3: Na honti kāye daddu ca, vipāko pattachaḍḍite.
segments.tha-ap530:10.3: Rogā na honti kāyasmiṃ, vipāko pattachaḍḍite.
segments.tha-ap530:11.3: Na hoti cittajā pīḷā, vipāko pattachaḍḍite.
segments.tha-ap530:14.3: Aggirājūhi corehi, na hoti udake bhayaṃ.
segments.tha-ap530:16.3: Tato na hāyate āyu, tiṭṭhate yāvatāyukaṃ.
segments.tha-ap530:17.1: “Abbhantarā ca bāhirā [bahicarā (sī. pī. ka.)], negamā ca saraṭṭhakā;
segments.tha-ap530:19.3: Sabbe te parirakkhanti, bhave saṃsarato sadā.
segments.tha-ap530:20.3: Avasāne ca nibbānaṃ, sivaṃ patto anuttaraṃ.
segments.tha-ap530:21.3: Yo puññaṃ pasave poso, tassa kiṃ nāma dullabhaṃ.
segments.tha-ap530:25.1: “Svāgataṃ vata me āsi … pe … kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
segments.tha-ap530:27.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā bodhisammajjako thero imā gāthāyo Abhāsitthāti.
